Best mini projectors in 2026

If you're looking for a mini projector for movies, Netflix, or travel, I'd prioritize picture quality, portability, and ease of setup over advertised resolution or brightness.

My top brands to consider are XGIMI, Anker Nebula, and Epson. The best model depends on whether you want something pocket-sized, battery-powered, or bright enough for a living room.

One important tip: Look for native 1080p resolution and brightness measured in ANSI or ISO lumens. Many cheap projectors advertise “4K support” but actually display a much lower resolution.
